policy: Three legal solo profiles: developing with half skill/talent budgets and no final masteries; developed common; developed rare. Six equipment slots; first specialization path with completed trials assumed. Two common-gear parties. Proactive barriers at most once per four rounds per hero.

metrics.aggregation: Each median is across trials; solo actions are player commands.
metrics.minimum_health_ratio: Minimum stored health/max_health within combat, before later healing; party minimum over all members.
metrics.received_damage: Sum of DAMAGE/CRIT event amounts aimed at measured heroes, after mitigation and before barrier, including overkill and periodic damage.
metrics.barrier_absorbed: Exact min(current barrier, damage amount) observed in Combatant.damaged; expiration and barrier refresh are excluded.
metrics.used_resource: All negative resource changes in stored fighter states with unchanged max_resource; not net spend. Includes hostile drains when present.
metrics.restored_resource: All positive resource changes in stored fighter states with unchanged max_resource, including passive recovery and refunds.
metrics.party: Damage, resource and absorption summed over measured members; health_spent is their mean final deficit.

limitations: Simulation, not live acceptance. One deterministic heuristic, not optimal play: no consumables, racial active use, PvP, all alternative builds or party compositions. Healing and attack scores are estimates; barriers are proactive only in longer fights; stealth is used to enable available stealth attacks, other control/buff sequences are not searched. One seed family; item seed is fixed per class/level. Equipment wear within a fight is real; each trial starts with repaired gear and full health/resource. Costs of repair, travel, trial quests and obtaining gear are not simulated.
